smallest_lawful_resolution: Open repository Settings > Rules > Rulesets > OVC main protection and inspect both required status-check source identities.
Re-select `tests` and `OVC tiered test selection shadow` from the current GitHub Actions check runs if their source binding is stale or absent; do not remove or weaken either requirement.
Confirm PR 216 shows both checks as satisfied under the ruleset rather than merely successful in Actions.
Issue `OVC CONTINUE` so the exact-head squash merge can be retried.
rollback: No destructive rollback. Preserve PR 216, both MTA-G0 branches, all decisions, checks and blocker evidence. If abandoned, close PR 216 without deleting branches.
